messages:
hana: Heads-up: found a funky onboarding hit in the Flutter/Dart starter when using JSON mode + function calling. The SDK helper coerces missing keys to null and the strict_output_schema path treats that as valid, which then crashes downstream in our mobile app (type mismatch). Repro and logs below.

omear: oh no — can you paste the repro?

hana: repro (minimal):
1) enable JSON mode in the flutter starter config (ENV JSON_MODE=true)
2) call function `get_profile` with arguments_schema expecting `\{"type\":\"object\",\"required\":[\"id\"],\"properties\":{\"id\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"age\":{\"type\":\"integer\"}}}`
3) downstream tool returns `\{"id\":\"u1\"}` (no age). Dart SDK helper injects `age: null` to satisfy schema and validator marks it as ok under permissive shim, then mobile code crashes when trying to call `.toInt()` on null.

snippet we send to the model:```json
{"model":"rw-flutter-1","mode":"json","function_call":{"name":"get_profile","arguments_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"age":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["id"]}}}
```

logs:```
[2026-04-08T09:12:01Z] WARN shim: missing key 'age' - injecting null to satisfy schema
[2026-04-08T09:12:01Z] INFO validator: permissive mode accepted null for integer
[2026-04-08T09:12:01Z] ERR mobile: Unhandled exception: NoSuchMethodError: The getter 'toInt' was called on null
```

leo: interesting. Dart SDK had a permissive shim to help lenient models, but injecting null for typed primitives is dangerous for strongly-typed clients. We intended the shim to only attempt coercion (e.g., string->number) when a value exists, not to fabricate keys.

megan: agreed. immediate mitigation: set env var `REDWOOD_DART_PERMISSIVE=false` in the flutter starter so the validator fails fast and surfaces a 4xx to the app. That unblocks the customer.

hana: pushed a tiny starter patch that flips the env var and added a note in README about null-injection risk in mobile runtimes. Customer unblocked.

omear: plan: change Dart SDK helper to 1) never fabricate keys/values, 2) on missing required keys emit validation error (fail-fast) unless an explicit opt-in `ALLOW_MISSING_KEYS` is true, 3) when coercing types prefer parse-over-inject. Also add a mobile integration test in starter-samples that runs the flutter flow with strict schema and missing keys.

ci-bot: CI: starter-samples/flutter-integration failed on `missing-key-null-inject` (https://ci/c/14001) :red_circle:

leo: I'll open the Dart SDK PR to change the shim and add tests + diagnostic telemetry when missing-key occur. Also update the SDK parity doc to explicitly call out that mobile SDKs should never inject nulls for primitives.

megan: thanks. also remind support to tell partners to toggle the env var if they see cryptic mobile crashes during onboarding. I'll draft a short support KB entry.

hana: added the reproducer gist to the PR and linked the support ticket. PR: https://repo/rw/dart-sdk/pull/67. tagging @leo for review. :thumbsup:

omear: timeline: small patch release for Dart SDK after green CI (24-48h). We'll coordinate a changelog note for starter-samples.

leo: good catch, hana. Mobile apps are less forgiving about silent shims; prefer loud errors.

megan: agreed. I'll update the starter README and add a short FAQ entry explaining why we fail-fast by default on mobile SDKs.
